Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.

Tab order is fixed: Pull requests, Issues, Board (only if the project names a GitHub Projects board), Review List, Files (if the server reads the repo), Run (Manage token + serve_branch), SSH sessions and SFTP sessions (Admin token),
Database, Forge, then 🎙 Meeting only while a meeting transcript exists.
Only the Review List and SSH/SFTP tabs carry counts; the SSH/SFTP count is open sessions.
Header buttons are laid right to left in array order, with 🎙 Meet always first (leftmost). Without room for labels they turn into icon buttons.

Each row is a raised card that opens the PR page when clicked. The errand buttons come from the server catalog and depend on the PR's state; the suggested one (*) is drawn prominent. ↳ Merge is hidden on drafts; 'N runs ›' shows
only when conversations ran on the PR. Pressing ▶ Run opens the PR's Run preview.

With a filter on, a 'Showing 3 of 12' line with an accent 'Clear filters' link on the right sits above the rows. Empty states: 'No open pull requests.' / 'No pull requests match the filters.' Loading: 'Loading pull requests…'.
The filter pickers open a popup menu: 'All authors', then each value with its count, e.g. 'nadin (3)'. The list polls every 45 s, and after a rate limit the header adds '· retry after 14:05'.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
